title: Manyhands JSON v1 poll mutation data
description: The data of a poll once envelope that has a report: a poll's pass as the domain reports it. Dirty, diverged, conflicted, malformed, deleted and incomplete targets are data, not failures. A restart reports what its own pass saw. merged lists the items whose done state arrived in the poll's own move of the primary. A poll whose first call stopped on a host that is not trusted carries synchronization_mutation data instead, and is followed by host approve and a new request: its stop is final. Guidance for each disposition is the front end's, from PollTargetDisposition::guidance.

next_eligible_at.description: The stored deadline of the next automatic poll. Null when none is stored.

items.description: One target. A malformed remote ref has every field but its disposition null: its name is not reported.

target.description: The local reference, or null for a malformed remote ref.

merged.description: The items whose done state arrived in this poll's own move of the primary: a ticket whose closure the new primary holds and the old one did not, a document whose content it holds anew. Ordered by kind and item ID; empty for a poll that moved nothing, and for an answer stored before this field existed. A retiring poll's list is frozen with its summary.

merged_at.description: When the first-parent commit that brought the item was made, as RFC 3339 UTC in whole seconds.

made_ready.description: For a ticket, the direct dependents that the index reads as open with every dependency closed, after the poll's refresh, in ID order. Empty unless made_ready_state is current. Null for a document.

made_ready_state.description: What made_ready is. current: the set read after the poll's refresh completed. index_pending: none, since the refresh had not completed or the index could not be read completely; ticket ready is the live view. Null for a document.
